Be of good cheer, Richard; step out—that’s it!’ ‘I do feel better,’ remarked Mr. Mason. ‘I am sure you do. Now, Jane, trip on before us away to the backstairs; unbolt the side-passage door, and tell the driver of the post-chaise you will see in the yard—or just outside, for I told him not to drive his rattling wheels over the pavement—to be ready; we are coming: and, Jane, if any one is about, come to the foot of the stairs and hem.’ It was by this time half-past five, and the sun was on the point of rising; but I found the kitchen still dark and silent.
